# newline

> > newline is a learning platform offering comprehensive courses, books, and tutorials on modern web development technologies including React, TypeScript, Vue.js, Angular, Next.js, and AI-assisted coding.

The platform provides both free articles and premium subscription content, focusing on practical, real-world projects across frontend frameworks, fullstack development, and emerging AI tools. Content ranges from beginner-friendly guides to advanced topics in asynchronous programming, build tools like Nx and pnpm, and automation with tools like Zapier and n8n.

## Key Topics

- React
- TypeScript
- JavaScript
- Next.js
- Vue.js
- Angular Signals
- React Server Components
- Supabase
- fullstack-development
- frontend-frameworks
- asynchronous-programming
- ChatGPT
- Bolt
- automation
- web-development
